game_title: Doubling Growth – Ore Vein Depths Defense
game_concept: A action defense set in Shadow Cave – Ore Vein Depths, a rich ore vein: the cave miner must handle shadow wraiths while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Doubling Growth: Double a size each pass with while size < goal to grow the cave gate fast.
theme: Shadow Cave – Ore Vein Depths: a rich ore vein
core_gameplay_loop: In Ore Vein Depths, repeat each round: Double a size each pass with while size < goal to grow the cave gate fast. Each round, shadow wraiths strike the cave gate, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the size value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the cave gate from shadow wraiths in Ore Vein Depths: keep the size meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 43-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: size drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 43-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 9 (extended tier): Doubling Growth
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Doubling Growth' (Week 4 slot 12), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Ore Vein Depths'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how size changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against shadow wraiths in Ore Vein Depths.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 43 seconds while size > 0.
